limits: Local draft documents are unaccepted input, not counterparty acceptance, a quote, verified fiat receipt or spending authority. Native peer acceptance remains an explicit compiled fixture capability; production carrier is undefined.

Policy changes retire current scopes/consent but cannot retract sent bytes or release ignored physical closes. A selected receipt is not a drain or private-route proof.
Fixture issuer renewal, loopback endpoints, public dev wallets and measured native/Chromium versions do not qualify production privacy/providers, real wallets/devices or funds enablement.
Current root App/catalog changes outside T80/T81 and final combined exact-head checks remain root responsibilities; passing these scoped receipts is not whole-product/release approval.
